BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.

2. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

4. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

7. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.

8. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.

9. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

10. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.

11. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.

12. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

3. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

5. A — CPU

6. B — Information and Communication Technology

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Computer Aided Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
